help.label: Activation
help.description: An activation occurs when an effect successfully triggers.

help.label: Average
help.description: A mean value: the total divided by the relevant number of turns, combats, floors, or activations.

help.label: Block
help.description: Block gained, retained, spent, or otherwise measured by a stat.

help.label: Card
help.description: A card or a count of cards.

help.label: Charge
help.description: A stored charge accumulated or used by a relic.

help.label: Combat
help.description: A combat encounter or a value measured across combats.

help.label: Floor
help.description: A run floor or a value measured across floors.

help.label: Healing blocked
help.description: Healing that was attempted but did not restore HP.

help.label: Healing gained
help.description: HP successfully restored by a healing effect.

help.label: Information
help.description: Hover this symbol beside a stat to read the row's full description.

help.label: Osty summon gained
help.description: An increase to Osty's summon amount.

help.label: Turn
help.description: A combat turn or a value measured across turns.

help.label: Upgraded
help.description: A card that received an upgrade, or an upgrade applied to a card.
